Product Features

  • Convenient Gold Size: Measuring 100 × 50 × 45 cm, the table is compact and space-saving, fits perfectly with most living room sizes in North America, and can be set up flexibly without taking up too much space.
  • Multifunctional Height Adjustment Design: The tabletop is height-adjustable and can be raised up to 58.5cm. This makes it easy to switch between coffee table, dining table and desk – you can do all your daily tasks with just one table.
  • Hidden, generous storage: The double design of the area under the height-adjustable tabletop and drawers offers plenty of space to organize utensils, documents, snacks and more - for a tidy living room.
  • High-gloss surface with high abrasion resistance: The white high-gloss surface is water- and dirt-repellent, easy to clean and remains as bright as new even after many years of use.
  • Stable, resilient construction: The body is made of high-quality particle wood, which is sturdy and durable. The recommended load capacity is up to 50 kg - even with daily use or as a dining table, the table is stable and wobble-free.
  • Smooth height adjustment thanks to high-quality mechanics: Equipped with a high-strength hydraulic lifting device, the height adjustment works smoothly and without stuttering. The table remains stable even under load and is durable and reliable.
  • Minimalist, versatile design: The simple, white high-gloss design goes well with modern, luxurious, Scandinavian and many other interior styles - the table is not only practical, but also a stylish decorative element.
  • Versatile in everyday use: Whether as a coffee table, desk, simple dining table or storage table for snacks - the table meets all the requirements for home office, relaxation and visits.
